long_biography.plain_text:
Before he became a private-equity founder, Brian Sheth worked in technology investment banking in San Francisco. He joined Robert F. Smith at Goldman Sachs and then helped launch Vista Equity Partners, where he developed an investment practice centred on acquiring and improving enterprise software companies. His work combined deal negotiation with attention to the operations of portfolio businesses.

After more than two decades at Vista, Sheth left and created Haveli Investments, an Austin firm focused on technology and gaming. Beyond finance, he helped his childhood friend Wes Sechrest establish Global Wildlife Conservation. He and his wife Adria also founded the Sheth Sangreal Foundation to support conservation and education; Re:wild now lists him among its emeritus board members.
long_biography.html:
Before he became a private-equity founder, Brian Sheth worked in technology investment banking in San Francisco. He joined Robert F. Smith at Goldman Sachs and then helped launch Vista Equity Partners, where he developed an investment practice centred on acquiring and improving enterprise software companies. His work combined deal negotiation with attention to the operations of portfolio businesses.

After more than two decades at Vista, Sheth left and created Haveli Investments, an Austin firm focused on technology and gaming. Beyond finance, he helped his childhood friend Wes Sechrest establish Global Wildlife Conservation. He and his wife Adria also founded the Sheth Sangreal Foundation to support conservation and education; Re:wild now lists him among its emeritus board members.
